correctness.rationale: On the positive disease-free branch m>a, differentiate all four no-spillover Park state equations. The healthy direction has eigenvalue -b and the K,I,Z infection block B is irreducible Metzler. The explicitly positive vector (k,1,v) makes B(k,1,v)=(0,h,0), with C h = H(b) and C>0. The strictly positive left Perron eigenvector proves sign s(B)=sign H, including a simple zero root at H=0. Since b(b+a+z) increases from zero, b0 is the unique positive root b(b+a+z)=dz, and b0<d; the affine environmental-conversion law gives three exhaustive strict-sign cases for all a,d,z,epsilon>0, 0<=delta<=1 and m>a. The movement polynomial has positive leading and negative constant coefficients, hence one positive root; implicit differentiation at it proves strict parameter monotonicity, and the environment-only root identity proves the reciprocal singular bracket. The separate standalone script used exact Fraction arithmetic and passed 729 rational tuples including two threshold witnesses. All-parameter conclusions use algebra/Perron, not finite testing. Nonlinear stability at the nonhyperbolic threshold and global persistence are expressly unproved.

originality.rationale: The model equations are due to Park (2012); novelty is restricted to the exact sharp local-invasion trichotomy, the environmental-conversion-independent nonzero movement floor, one increasing-movement crossing, and an explicit no-direct-transmission weak-conversion bracket. The Park forward-model, results and discussion were inspected and did not exhibit this threshold analysis. Previously known metapopulation disease models and standard Metzler theory do not directly yield the exact specialized parameter-domain statement. Semantic research-record searches found related invasion threshold mathematics but no equivalent five-state environment-contaminated-patch statement. Historical priority remains provisional; full coverage of the older Hess and Gog articles was inaccessible.
residual_risks: Historical priority cannot be guaranteed; inaccessible complete Hess (1996) and Gog et al. (2002) might contain a dominating general threshold.
An unidentified general positive-systems or epidemiological M-matrix theorem could subsume the scalar formula or floor.
The original five-state model is idealized: heterogeneity, stochastic establishment and external spillover are excluded.
The strict H=0 nonhyperbolic case has no proven nonlinear classification.

value.rationale: The source defines a natural tension between disease invasion and host patch persistence: m>a is needed for positive disease-free patch occupancy, but infection has a separate, explicit, positive movement floor a+b0 that persists even as environmental conversion approaches infinity. This is a nonroutine structural boundary for the exact established five-state patch ecology model, rather than an arbitrary selected parameter computation. A complete all-positive-parameter classification plus a unique movement threshold and sharp no-direct-infection asymptotic quantify relevant model sensitivities. Value is mathematical/model-structural, not a claim about field policy, global dynamics, or sampled outbreak risk.
